prompt:
Please turn each of the photos I uploaded into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-photo stitching, each photo output separately. The overall layout uses a 3:4 vertical composition, and the top and bottom areas are strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper part retains the original photo, maintaining the subject identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural light and shadow and original color atmosphere, only light high-level color grading to give it the texture of art magazines and exhibition images. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted or changed.

The lower part only extracts the most recognizable **subject, outline, structure, posture and narrative relationship** from the photo, and reconstructs it into a **hand-sewn textile collage illustration**. Do not keep all objects, do not re-draw object by object, do not copy the original scene; actively delete most of the background and irrelevant details, use only a few large pieces of cloth, simple silhouettes, layered fabrics, raw-edged patches and a small amount of embroidery to re-summarize the core visual information, making it recognizable at a glance as corresponding to the photo above.

The lower part must use **a large amount of white space** as the core compositional language. The subject should be compressed into a smaller, more refined visual focus, with the remaining space left blank in large areas; white space is not an empty background, but an important part of the picture itself, forming a sense of breath, space and rhythm together with the subject, the edge of the cloth and the stitches. Eccentricity, edge-hugging, suspension or local cropping are allowed, re-directing the original image into a more valid and advanced work through subtraction, recombination, scale changes and white space.

The material emphasizes cotton and linen fibers, fabric textures, hand stitches, irregular cuts, slight dislocations and real touch, presenting a warm, restrained, and lifestyle textile collage / appliqué texture. Avoid complex perspectives, fragmented depictions, crowded screens and cheap handmade feel.

Extract 2–4 of the most vibrant, lifestyle-warm colors that represent the theme's spirit from the photo above, moderately brighten, purify, and de-gray them to make the fabric colors vivid, soft, and friendly. The overall look is bright, warm, and natural, avoiding dull, gray, old, and gloomy color schemes.

Text is only involved as a minimal editorial intervention, with no language restrictions. A small number of words or short sentences can be freely generated based on the subject, location, action, emotion or metaphor, quietly falling on the white space or the edge of the subject, forming a refined relationship between graphics and text.

The overall visual effect is a high-end combination of **selective refinement, textile collage, hand stitching, vivid fabrics, a huge amount of artistic white space and editorial layout**. Avoid object-by-object copying, excessive background retention, information accumulation, screen filling, complex scenes, cartoon feel, 3D feel and stylized templates.
